instructions.name: create_venue
docs: "Create a market": a new venue backed by a registered pump.fun token.

instructions.name: enable_platform_collateral
docs: Enable only the configured core settlement asset as a bet token.
Devnet's platform mint has no mainnet source token before launch.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The venue pool; its settlement token is this venue's core stake.

instructions.name: observe
docs: Frozen ER intents cannot be re-observed or repriced on the base layer.

instructions.name: open
docs: Trading is only available through delegated ER state.

accounts.name: config
docs: The root or any venue config; each venue pauses independently.

accounts.name: payer
docs: DLP verifies this is the original delegation rent payer.

instructions.name: recycle_position
docs: Reinvest completed position/receipt rent in the next trade, atomically.
The following PrepareSettlement and InitializeOwnership are mandatory: a sponsored
account's rent cannot be withdrawn as a free SOL grant.

instructions.name: redeem_usdc
docs: Permissionless FIFO settlement. All sizing and destination checks are on chain;
a keeper pays network fees but cannot redirect funds or choose the claim debit.

accounts.name: config
docs: Any config: every venue shares the root's USD quote mint.

instructions.name: register_quote_collateral
docs: Register only the configured six-decimal settlement quote as dollar collateral.

instructions.name: route_buyback
docs: Buy and burn SDICE with a venue's 1% allocation, without spending root inventory.

errors.name: History
errors.msg: Observation history gap; settlement cannot be proven

errors.name: QueueOrder
errors.msg: Earlier FIFO claims must be paid first

errors.name: ClaimLimit
errors.msg: Payout exceeds approved USD claim debit

errors.name: Maker
errors.msg: A valid funded maker signature is required

errors.name: GasBudget
errors.msg: Gas reserve spending limit or balance reached

fields.name: entry_price
docs: USD/token in 1e12 units, captured from the entry observation. Supply,
historical swap fees and bag size cannot change this price baseline.

fields.name: last_gap
docs: A position spanning a monitoring outage cannot claim an unverified win.

types.name: CollateralRecovery
docs: The existing trusted publisher attests an archived replay. This is not a
trustless historical-state proof. Every immutable close field is bound to
prevent cross-position reuse, and recovery can only reduce the stored floor.

fields.name: available
docs: Total user custody, including collateral reserved by open ER positions.

fields.name: prices
docs: Sequence s is stored at s % 64. The current sequence identifies exactly
which 64 entries remain, so storing a second u64 per entry is redundant.

fields.name: markets
docs: Always initialized with exactly ER_MARKETS elements. Vec deserializes
each market directly onto the heap instead of materializing a large array.

fields.name: total_outflows
docs: Includes operational refills and explicit surplus withdrawals, not just network fees.

fields.name: usd_per_quote_atom_e21
docs: USD per quote-token atom, scaled by 1e21. For SOL this equals the old
SOL/USD e12 field exactly; for USDC it is 1e15. Layout and existing bytes
are unchanged. Other quote tokens need an executable conversion route;
a spot multiplier must not replace a multi-pool collateral sale.

fields.name: quote_reserve
docs: Real reserve plus the signed virtual adjustment, in quote-token atoms.

types.name: SolUsdQuote
docs: The existing publisher signs this price in the settlement transaction itself.
Pool reserves are read on chain; no separate base price-update transaction is
needed. This preserves the same SOL/USD convention used for ER entry quotes.

fields.name: buyback_received
docs: Swap-quote atoms moved into the buyback vault by settlements.

fields.name: buyback_spent
docs: Swap-quote atoms spent on SDICE by `route_buyback`.

fields.name: sdice_burned
docs: SDICE atoms purchased and burned (never credited to root treasury).
